before.title: Ethernet list crashes when the cable is not managed by NetworkManager; NetBird and Wi-Fi stop refreshing
Power tab puts back an old power mode after Home changed it
Mobile: an action pressed while the modem is busy is silently dropped (the PIN too)
Closing the window loses changes still waiting to be saved (info circle, windows, icons, equaliser, volume)
Login look: two saves can run at once and the older one can win
Audio → Use ignores the equaliser, Home then shows the wrong output
Wi-Fi errors (wrong password) were never shown
A hanging root helper cannot be stopped by the app (mobile, power, look)
Red dot: the app and the key service both write it, the wrong pattern can stay
Audio lists rebuild on every change: unsaved ticks reset, open menus close
Home volume slider does nothing when "Together" is the output
Widgets read from worker threads (audio, face, network)
Bluetooth pairing can say "failed" although it worked
Slow commands on the window's thread at start (webcam, equaliser, notes scan, fonts)
Equaliser off waits 3 seconds for nothing (audio gap)
"Use the cable" breaks a hand-made static network setup
Hardware list can show the state from before your click
Printers: "Added" / "Forgotten" message is wiped at once
Theme apply can make a second, ownerless window
Windows apply: a change can be missed, or half written when closing
A missing command leaves parts of the app stuck on "…"
A sending device can make the receiver write (and delete) outside the transfer folder
Keys and logins arrive readable by other users; SSH keys unusable; scripts lose their run bit
Old sessions never expire: a device that once received can come back for everything
One unreadable file makes the transfer retry for ever
The receiver takes files it did not ask for, and writes through linked folders into the repo
Files are not checked after transfer (a damaged or cut file counts as done)
The 6-digit code can be guessed without limit
The window freezes or stops updating while comparing received files
"Close the apps" loop on any permission error; other errors stop the background step
Two fetches can run at once and damage a file
After a sender ended, the next "Send" stops within a second
The sender stops under a reopened window
Folders of abandoned transfers (with copied keys) are never removed
On Ubuntu 24.04 pairing hangs (needs Python 3.13)
Wi-Fi names/passwords with : or \\ import wrong; password visible on a command line
Bad data from the other side leaves the window on "Connecting…"
Notes and Files both have "Recent": one shows the other's items
An action finishing after you switched part lands in the wrong part
A big image preview freezes the Dialer (and the whole desktop while it holds the keys)
Parts refreshed while being drawn: a broken frame; early Music buttons do nothing
A hung network folder blocks that part until the Dialer restarts
A broken config makes the next Super press kill the Dialer
A slow leak on every opening
A face check started just before hibernate could still unlock after it
Password marker check accepts "." names (harmless today)

after.title: "Nothing leaves this laptop" switches itself off after one bad line in the settings file
With "nothing leaves this laptop" on, the status check still contacts Anthropic and Mistral
The shared chat can carry answers made on the laptop to a cloud engine from the other app
The Dialer can send a conversation in an order local Mistral models refuse
Long chats overflow the local model, which then fails until "New chat"
Chat-file and client code copied between three apps (already drifted apart)
after.state: partly: the chat and the address check are shared now; three small clients still copied (in DEVS)

after.title: Ask can stay stuck on "Stop" after a disk error
A local model id is not checked against the list
The Dialer gives up after 3 minutes on a slow local answer
Dialer and Intelligence write the chat file without a lock (wrong pairs, a lost message)
The Dialer does not show an answer finished in Intelligence until reopened
The claude engine still loads your own Claude hooks, plugins and memory
zorro-ai ask reports failure when it answered without the service
Stopping the service by hand leaves a running answer behind
Two quick taps on a greyed device start two connects
Closing the window during the countdown keeps a bad screen layout (no picture until you log in again)
A connected screen that is off gets switched on by any other change
A second change within the countdown undoes the first
"Put back" fails for a rotated screen and says it worked
Keep can show with nothing waiting, and then crashes
Any website open in the laptop's browser can post answers or use the design chat
"Home network only" also means any café or hotel network
A device on the network can fill the disk with answers
The design chat can stay on "writing…" for ever after an error
A slow or broken request can tie up the page server
The stick writer opens the file as root before checking it
A stick with an opened encrypted volume is overwritten while in use
After swapping sticks, Write erases the new one without asking again
The cable keeps its address only after the next restart, not at once
"Used when you plug it in" is promised but not built
The rules check skips new files that are not committed yet
The same address check is copied in three apps
after.state: partly: the chat and the address check are shared now; three small clients still copied (in DEVS)

after.title: Ask-once timers: a warning on close, and an old one can end a new question
A machine installed from the ISO cannot fetch updates (its copy is not a git repo)
Home and DEVS cannot be opened by address
Any website open in the browser can create items, write plan answers and start the checks
A website can pose as the laptop to the browser and read DEVS (no check of the address asked for)
The automatic checks can be started over and over, keeping the laptop busy
A stranger on the network can block pairing for hours
Before pairing, a device can make the sender use gigabytes of memory
The send port answers any address, not only the home network
A paired sender can lie about a file's size and fill the disk or memory
One file with a very long name stops everything after it
With many files the progress window stutters (a big list rewritten twice a second)
Your own account silently gets the sender's groups (admin, input)
After the admin step, another program could make an admin account for a few minutes
"Home network" also means café Wi-Fi and the mobile network
Some internet address ranges pass as "private"
One device can keep three "wants your setup" notifications a minute on screen
A rogue device with your laptop's name can replace it in the list (the code stays safe)
A disk read error in the middle of a file retries for 30 minutes
A paired receiver can make the sender load 2 GB into memory
Deeply nested data from the other side kills the background fetch
A real file named X.part or X.meta can be damaged while staging
Old session secrets pile up in the sender's state
Pairing from the command line during a running fetch deletes its files
Any Transfer window keeps a closed sender alive
A paired receiver can crash the Send page's progress
Slow connections can tie up the DEVS server
A paired sender can place start-up programs and login keys (by design; now listed)
